minecraft:written_book_content.title: Recovered: Personal Log (E.V.)
minecraft:written_book_content.author: E. Vance
pages: They gave me his file to study like he was a stranger. My own grandfather, reduced to a case number and a risk assessment.
I am supposed to guide the agents in. I am supposed to keep them calm, keep them useful. I am supposed to not tell them what's really down there.

I tell myself I'm doing this to find him. To pull one coherent piece of him back out.

I am not sure that's still true. I am not sure UMBRA ever intended to let me.
